answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one sable weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The dune report makes public the merge explicitly at each pulse. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 68 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 189 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4247 identities would post 4839 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
